title: Nitrogen — molecular gas supplement and preserved table inventory, 2026-10-06
body:
# Nitrogen — molecular gas supplement and preserved table inventory, 2026-10-06

Stage: IMPLEMENTED. Actual terminal results are recorded in the [batch receipt](../../data/quality/thermal-nitrogen-batch-2026-10-06.json); wider scientific and image acceptance remains PARTIAL.

## Identity, source and applicable state

The [unchanged master](../../records/0007-Nitrogen-N/data/structured/0007-Nitrogen-N.yaml) owns MAT:0007:MOL:N2 at /ordinary_molecular_state. Atomic MAT:0007:ATOM:N, cryogenic/condensed, isotope, magnetic, reactive-nitrogen and cg-N contexts remain separate. The [NIST official SI publisher table](https://webbook.nist.gov/cgi/cbook.cgi?ID=C7727379&Units=SI&Mask=1&Type=JANAFG&Table=on) identifies N2, CAS 7727-37-9, InChI=1S/N2/c1-2, with GAS fits covering **100–500 K, 500–2000 K and 2000–6000 K** on **mol N2** basis. Molecular functions are not converted into atomic functions by dividing by two.

New SRC-000515 is a dated retrieval of the same work as SRC-000102 in the [canonical registry](../../data/registries/sources.yaml), preserving the older spectroscopy metadata and source identity. [Exact main-page bytes](../../data/catalog/sources/nist-thermochemistry-0007-2026-10-06.html.txt) and [publisher-table bytes](../../data/catalog/sources/nist-thermochemistry-0007-2026-10-06-table.html.txt) retain hashes. Chase (1998), March 1977 data review, January 2009 parameter fit and October 2026 retrieval are distinct provenance events. Retained copyright does not imply an open redistribution licence; publication review remains open.

## Calculations and limits

All **62 publisher rows / 186 Cp-S-H comparisons** passed at published precision. Shared-library review checked **303 samples / 909 quantities**, 24 range refusals and seven context probes. Both 500 K and 2000 K endpoints remain separate by column, including the rounded heat-capacity difference at 2000 K. No average, forced continuity, transition or equilibrium population is inferred. The calculated reference-enthalpy residual is retained. Pressure, coefficient uncertainty/covariance and isotope/spin populations remain UNKNOWN or UNSPECIFIED-IN-RETAINED-FIT. The separate one-bar CODATA entropy uncertainty is not a fit uncertainty. No extrapolation, condensed function, cg-N prediction, dissociation/ionisation fraction, EOS, latent heat or phase boundary is accepted.

## Preserved records and outputs

The additive [table inventory](../../records/0007-Nitrogen-N/data/structured/0007-Nitrogen-N-Table-Manifest.yaml) links ten unchanged authored tables with IDs 001–010; their scientific-content review remains pending. Table 011 and graph 013 are new. The twelve original [graph reservations](../../records/0007-Nitrogen-N/data/structured/0007-Nitrogen-N-Graph-Manifest.yaml), including the earlier graph002 filename/manifest mismatch, remain intact. The parent and graph-manifest original prefixes are byte-identical.

The [reader chapter](../../records/0007-Nitrogen-N/0007-Nitrogen-N-Thermochemistry.md), [structured evaluation](../../records/0007-Nitrogen-N/data/structured/0007-Nitrogen-N-NIST-Thermochemistry.yaml), [readable table](../../records/0007-Nitrogen-N/tables/0007-Nitrogen-N-TABLE-011-Thermodynamic-Functions.md), [CSV](../../records/0007-Nitrogen-N/tables/0007-Nitrogen-N-TABLE-011-Thermodynamic-Functions.csv) and [SVG heat-capacity chart](../../records/0007-Nitrogen-N/graphs/0007-Nitrogen-N-GRAPH-013-Heat-Capacity.svg) share canonical subject, source, units, ranges and unknowns. Existing curated append, extractor, sync, plot and publishing tools were reused. No production-code, schema or permanent-identity change was needed.

Independent source/software arithmetic and output reviewers passed; the actual native PNG was visually inspected. Preservation checks cover 5,205 prior record files, 41 prior thermal owners, 71 gaps, 123 earlier artifacts and 406 existing source nodes. The SRM126c owner, certificate, source, four artifacts and typed projection are unchanged; only its registry-input hash was refreshed. Review assumptions and one Windows launcher error were corrected in private check scripts with failed evidence retained. These checks establish bounded software/source integration; independent scientific acceptance and experimental replication remain pending.

Global coverage is **42 thermal owners / 143 fits / 14,443 calculated rows / 71 source gaps / 270 supplemental charts**. All 119 canonical identities remain represented. All 143 master tasks, 4,248 confirmed-domain reviews and 2,587 standalone confirmed-element panels remain pending. This chart earns zero A/B panel credit. The [existing selector](../../data/research/mat-update-review.json), [MAT TODO](../../data/quality/MAT-TODO.json), [resume](../../MAT-ADVANCED-RESUME.md) and [handoff](../../MAT_CODEX_CONTINUATION_HANDOFF.md) preserve these boundaries. Final test/build/browser/copy results are recorded only after actual completion in the receipt.

## Next executable requirement

Review Oxygen 0008 molecular O2 GAS using the private preflight .mat-local/thermal-nitrogen-2026-10-06/oxygen-next-preflight.md and retained primary captures. Bind MAT:0008:MOL:O2 at /ordinary_molecular_state with mol O2 basis; the atomic MAT:0008:ATOM:O reference is a string at /oxygen_species/0, not a /states/0 owner, and the separate ASD /entries/0 evaluation is not an O2 thermal state. Independently review all three source intervals 100–700, 700–2000 and 2000–6000 K and the 62 publisher rows before accession; retain both shared endpoint rows, unknown pressure/coefficient uncertainty/isotope/spin scope and the published enthalpy reference. Preserve tables 001–010 through an additive inventory and all graph reservations 001–012; candidate table 011/graph 013 require fresh collision and owner-hash checks. Resolve the dated NIST WebBook work against SRC-000127 / SRC-O-002 using same_work_as; SRC-000133 is separate cryogenic work. Recompute an unreserved source ID; none is reserved by the preflight. Reuse curated append, exact-source retention, bounded extractor/sync/plot and full publication/integrity/browser/copy gates. Continue 0009–0012 individually afterwards. Universal atomic-child projection, 71 bounded thermal source gaps, remaining domains, historical source metadata, independent scientific acceptance and standalone image panels remain pending; MAT stays PARTIAL.

sources.scope_note: Dated SI response for the existing NIST WebBook Nitrogen/N2 work owned by SRC-000102. Preserve that older node, aliases and spectroscopy supports; this retrieval is not a second independent work.
sources.scope: The retained species is molecular N2 (CAS 7727-37-9, InChI=1S/N2/c1-2), GAS, with one mole of N2 molecules containing two moles of nitrogen atoms. Bind MAT:0007:MOL:N2 at /ordinary_molecular_state; do not bind MAT:0007:ATOM:N or convert molecular functions to atomic functions by dividing by two. Source aliases including Nitrogen-14 and reported molecular weight do not specify isotopic fractions. Isotope composition and spin-isomer scope are UNSPECIFIED-IN-RETAINED-FIT. No dissociation, ionisation fraction, equilibrium composition or spin population is derived. Three GAS columns cover 100–500 K, 500–2000 K and 2000–6000 K. Keep both publisher rows at 500 K and 2000 K tied to their separate source columns; the rounded 2000 K heat capacities differ. Do not merge, average or impose continuity, infer a transition, or extrapolate below 100 K or above 6000 K. Existing atomic, liquid/cryogenic, phase-reference, cg-N and ammonia reaction owners remain separate. Retain the published enthalpy reference and any calculated reference residual rather than forcing zero. Retain Chase 1998, the reported March 1977 data review, January 2009 parameter fit, and 2026-10-06 retrieval as distinct provenance. The Shomate equations have no pressure variable; preserve their reported standard-state quantities and the separate gas, one-bar entropy datum without assigning an arbitrary sample pressure. Coefficient uncertainty and covariance are UNKNOWN. Separate CODATA entropy uncertainty, publisher output rounding and software arithmetic residuals are not coefficient uncertainty or independent measurement confirmation. This candidate capture and independent arithmetic review do not accept science, establish calorimetry or experimental replication, or complete Nitrogen thermophysics. A newly dated snapshot should record same_work_as SRC-000102; its old spectroscopy supports and identity ownership are preserved.
sources.reference: Chase, M.W., Jr. (1998), NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables, Fourth Edition. Retain March 1977 data review and January 2009 parameter-fit comments as distinct provenance.
